label: Start of copy phase in long sequences (delimiter and first two recalls)
explanation: Fires mainly on the first three output steps: the <DEL> step (rate 0.23, 38% of mass), the step that outputs original token 1 (0.20, 35%) and the one that outputs token 2 (0.11, 16%). Rate climbs steeply with L (L=9 holds 47% of mass) and with to_go (0.33 at to_go=8). The strongest activations sit on the step right after <DEL>, where the fed-back input is orig(0). It is almost silent in the original phase (5% of mass), apart from a small rise at late positions in L=8-9 sequences and on inputs n/u/g, and it barely fires on mid-copy steps. A weak tail comes back at the last copy steps of long sequences. Within the window, firing also depends on the tokens involved: in_tok n/u/g and out_tok k/z/l/h/3 have higher rates. That token dependence is spread across many tokens and I could not capture it, which is why precision is only about 0.3. The predicate reaches dev F1 0.43 with mass recall 0.78.
